title: Office & Commercial Movers in Pomona | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Commercial movers in Pomona for staged office relocations: a certificate of insurance for your building, truck routes planned and crews 8AM to 6PM.
heroSubtitle: Staged office relocations for Pomona businesses, planned around building access and city truck routes

faq.question: Will you take a weekend date for our office?
faq.answer: Yes. Crews work Monday through Sunday inside an 8AM – 6PM day, so a weekend stage is the usual way to keep a business open. We do not run night shifts, and a job too large for one day is split into stages instead.

faq.question: Our landlord wants a certificate of insurance. Can you issue one?
faq.answer: Yes, for $50 per building that asks for it. Send the exact entity names the management office requires and the certificate goes out before the date is locked. Most offices want the freight lift or dock booked in the same conversation, and we handle that call with them.

faq.question: Where will the truck stand if our building has no loading dock?
faq.answer: That spot is chosen before move day. Heavy trucks may not stay on Pomona streets overnight, and downtown the Vehicle Parking District regulates 25 public lots with timed, permit and lease parking. Where curb space has gone, as on Garey Avenue, we load from a side street, an alley or one of those lots.

faq.question: How is an office move priced?
faq.answer: Hours, crew size and the day of the week set the rate. A two-mover crew with a truck runs $119 in cash from Monday to Thursday and $129 on a card, rising to $135 and $145 between Friday and Sunday; three- and four-mover crews go from $159 up to $225 on the same pattern. A $30 fuel charge applies, and the $50 deposit comes off the total.

faq.question: Can the move be split across more than one day?
faq.answer: Yes, and most business jobs here are. Every stage is billed for the hours worked, against a three-hour minimum that becomes four once an address lies over 30 miles out. If the load stays on the truck between stages, overnight storage is $200.

faq.question: How soon can a crew start?
faq.answer: Same-day work is possible when a crew is free, although a staged relocation is better booked once the building has confirmed lift and dock access. Ring 909-443-0004, describe the suite and name the date, and the crew size and the expected hours come back to you in writing.
